I have some schooling so I can read the fertilizer bag, but I still do what my neighbors do and what worked last year. This plot is only 0.10 hectares, so I bought DAP and urea for my whole farm and will put a small share here — about 25 kilograms of nitrogen per hectare — and I will also add manure because the land is mine. My cousin's hybrid maize yielded well last season, so I bought improved seed too. My family will weed and harvest by hand over about 15 days this season, and I will not hire anyone.
